# Situation scope: safe clamped progress increments (0..100).
oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_small_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress add = 3 }
	if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_wdr_global_progress > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 100 } }
}

oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_medium_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress add = 6 }
	if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_wdr_global_progress > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 100 } }
}

oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_large_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress add = 10 }
	if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_wdr_global_progress > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 100 } }
}

# Country scope: upgrade one owned Tier 2 Megaproject to Tier 3.

	if = {
		limit = { owns = location:suez location:suez = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:oe_v49_wdr_suez_canal value = 2 } } }

		}
